title: Finish the Pattern · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Finish the Pattern · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Agree on a two-sound pattern, such as clap then tap. A partner performs the pattern twice, then the lead performs the next two sounds. The lead continues the agreed pattern correctly. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: A timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Finish the Pattern, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The lead continues the agreed pattern correctly.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The lead continues the agreed pattern correctly.
